name: Spikewheel
description: Spikewheel was a droid scavenger who captained the starship Salvage-1. A group of scavengers, including the Nikto Gritz, hoped to join her crew, though Spikewheel was only interested in recruiting Gritz as her first mate aboard the Salvage-1.

data.name: Spikewheel
data.death: Between 32 BBY and 20 BBY, Salvage-1, above Lotho Minor
